models.name: todo_list_configurations
models.description:
System-wide configuration settings for the todo list application.

Stores application-wide settings that control behavior and appearance of the
application. These configurations apply across all users and devices, providing
centralized control over system behavior.

Configuration settings include:

- Application name and branding
- Default settings for new users
- Feature toggles for experimental features
- System-wide limits and constraints
- Integration settings with external services

The configuration table serves as a central repository for system-wide
settings that can be modified by administrators to control application behavior
without requiring code changes.

This table is critical for maintaining consistent behavior across the
application and enabling centralized administration of system-wide parameters.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the configuration setting.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Value of the configuration setting.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable description of the configuration setting.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the configuration setting. Valid values: active, inactive.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration setting was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration setting was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration setting was deleted (soft delete).

models.name: todo_list_users
models.description:
User accounts for the todo list application.

Stores core user information including authentication credentials and
account status. Each user has a unique email address and username.
Passwords are stored as secure hashes. Users can have multiple login
methods (email, username, social media).

Supports soft deletion to allow account recovery while maintaining audit
trails. Includes timestamps for account creation and last update.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's email address for authentication and communication. Must be unique across all users.

plainFields.name: username
plainFields.description: User's chosen username for authentication. Must be unique across all users.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Secure hash of user's password. Never store plain text passwords.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was soft-deleted. Null if account is active.

models.name: todo_list_user_sessions
models.description:
User session records for tracking active user sessions.

Stores information about active user sessions including IP address, connection
context, and session duration. Each session is associated with a specific
user account and session type.

Supports session expiration and provides audit trail for user activity.
Includes timestamps for session creation and expiration.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: User account associated with this session. {@link todo_list_users.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the page where the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led to the session initiation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expired or was terminated. Null if session is active.

plainFields.name: referrer

plainFields.name: created_at

models.name: todo_list_user_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset records for user account recovery.

Stores information about password reset requests including reset token, IP
address, and connection context. Each reset record is associated with a
specific user account.

Provides audit trail for password reset activity. Includes timestamps
for reset requests and completions.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: User account associated with this password reset. {@link todo_list_users.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Secure token for password reset verification. Must be unique and time-limited.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the password reset request was made.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the page where the password reset request was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led to the password reset request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was created.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset was completed. Null if reset is pending.

models.name: todo_list_todo_items
models.description:
Core todo item entity representing tasks that users need to complete.

Stores the fundamental task information including title, description, and due date.
Each todo item is associated with a specific user and has a status and priority.
Supports soft deletion to allow for task recovery and history tracking.

This entity forms the central focus of the todo list application, allowing users to
manage their tasks through creation, modification, and completion tracking.
The todo item maintains relationships with user accounts, status types, and
priority levels to provide comprehensive task management capabilities.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: User who owns this todo item. {@link todo_list_users.id}

foreignFields.name: todo_list_todo_item_status_id
foreignFields.description: Current status of this todo item. {@link todo_list_todo_item_statuses.id}

foreignFields.name: todo_list_todo_item_priority_id
foreignFields.description: Priority level of this todo item. {@link todo_list_todo_item_priorities.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the todo item. Must be between 1 and 100 characters.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the todo item. Can be up to 1000 characters.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Date and time when the todo item is due. Must be in the future.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was soft-deleted. Null if not deleted.

models.name: todo_list_todo_item_statuses
models.description:
Enumeration of possible statuses for todo items.

Defines the lifecycle states that todo items can transition through, providing
clear visibility into task progress. Statuses include pending, in-progress,
completed, and archived, allowing users to track task completion and
prioritize their workload effectively.

This entity serves as a reference table for todo item statuses, enabling
consistent status management across the application. The predefined status
values ensure standardized task tracking and reporting capabilities.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Name of the status. Must be one of: pending, in-progress, completed, archived.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the status meaning and usage.

models.name: todo_list_todo_item_priorities
models.description:
Enumeration of possible priority levels for todo items.

Defines the importance levels that can be assigned to todo items, allowing
users to prioritize their tasks effectively. Priority levels include low,
medium, high, and critical, enabling clear task prioritization and
workload management.

This entity serves as a reference table for todo item priorities, enabling
consistent priority management across the application. The predefined priority
levels ensure standardized task prioritization and reporting capabilities.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Name of the priority level. Must be one of: low, medium, high, critical.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the priority level meaning and usage.
